country.match: Match each famous route to the country it is in.
country.odd: Three of these famous routes are in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Suez Canal
rows.hook: joins the Mediterranean to the Red Sea, saving ships the long trip around Africa

rows.label: Panama Canal
rows.hook: lifts ships over a continental divide through giant locks, linking the Atlantic and Pacific

rows.label: Oregon Trail
rows.description: historic migration route spanning Independence, MO–Oregon City, OR
rows.hook: carried covered-wagon pioneers west from Missouri in the 1800s

rows.label: Appalachian Trail
rows.description: 2,198.4-mile (3,538 km) trail going through fourteen US states managed by the National Park Service
rows.hook: is a famous hiking-only footpath running from Georgia to Maine

rows.label: Erie Canal
rows.hook: linked the Hudson River to the Great Lakes and boosted New York's rise as a trading hub

rows.label: Trans-Siberian railway
rows.description: railway line between Moscow, the Russian Far East and the Sea of Japan
rows.hook: is the longest train line in the world, running from Moscow to Vladivostok

rows.label: Appian Way
rows.description: Roman highway from Rome, Italy, to Brundisium 312 BC
rows.hook: is the ancient Roman road nicknamed the queen of the long roads

rows.label: Grand Canal
rows.description: longest canal or artificial river in the world located in China
rows.hook: is the longest artificial waterway on Earth, linking Beijing with Hangzhou

rows.label: Pacific Crest Trail
rows.description: long-distance hiking and equestrian trail in the USA
rows.hook: runs from the Mexican border to the Canadian border along the Sierra Nevada and Cascades

rows.label: Trans-Canada Highway
rows.description: highway and highway system in Canada
rows.hook: crosses all ten provinces, from Victoria to St. John's
